newsitem.title: USA: Unify signs licensing pact with Chinese.
newsitem.headline: Unify signs licensing pact with Chinese.

text.p: Unify Corp said Monday it has agreed to a licensing and registration plan with the government of the People's Republic of China under which users can register previously unlicensed software.
Unify said the program is the first significant software industry development following the recent Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) trade negotiations between the United States and China.
"Unify's licensing program is an excellent model for software companies doing business in China," Robert Bannerman, Commercial Attache for the U.S. said in a statement.
